finding.summary: Reachable account screens claimed Stripe payment and payout actions even when the server used an unbacked memory transport.
finding.risk: A user could reasonably mistake a local or test representation for a real approved marketplace payment provider.

implementedBoundary.capabilitySource: Authenticated, account-bound and no-store server capability response
implementedBoundary.checkout: Shown as available only when a real Stripe transport is configured and the account is eligible
implementedBoundary.payoutOnboarding: Shown and executable only under the same provider-backed account capability
implementedBoundary.bookingQuote: Uses the same server capability truth before declaring a payment method available
implementedBoundary.unavailableUi: Names no provider, presents no payment or payout action and requests no card, bank or identity data
implementedBoundary.testUi: Explicitly identifies test mode and states that no real money moves
implementedBoundary.helpContent: Uses provider-neutral wording until a provider is actually enabled
implementedBoundary.testHarnessException: Memory onboarding remains executable only when the backend deployment environment is exactly test; it is never exposed as a staging or production capability

serviceBoundary.push: Firebase Cloud Messaging remains included, voluntary and default off in the next candidate
serviceBoundary.crash: Firebase Crashlytics remains included, separate from push, voluntary and default off in the next candidate

verification.backendOverallAccounting: 209 passed, 1 intentional PostgreSQL skip without TEST_DATABASE_URL
